title_zh: 医院门诊 & 承包商安全管理（一）
title_en: Day1: Hospital Outpatient & Contractor Safety Management (I)

vocab.example_en: All contractors must complete pre-qualification before site access.
vocab.example_zh: 所有承包商入场前必须完成资格预审。

vocab.example_en: Subcontractors must follow the same E. H. S. standards as the prime contractor.
vocab.example_zh: 分包商必须遵守与主承包商相同的 E. H. S. 标准。

vocab.example_en: The office based team coordinates daily operations with the on-site crew.
vocab.example_zh: 驻场办公团队与现场作业队伍协调日常工作。

vocab.example_en: Facilities support services cover utilities, cleaning, and building maintenance.
vocab.example_zh: 厂务后勤服务涵盖水电气、清洁和楼宇维护。

vocab.example_en: Grounds maintenance crews must wear high-visibility vests at all times.
vocab.example_zh: 场地维护人员必须全程穿戴反光背心。

vocab.example_en: Landscaping work near power lines requires an electrical safety review.
vocab.example_zh: 靠近电力线的园林绿化作业需要电气安全评审。

vocab.example_en: Janitorial services staff receive training on chemical handling and slip prevention.
vocab.example_zh: 保洁服务人员接受化学品操作与防滑培训。

vocab.example_en: Pest control applicators must carry their certification on site.
vocab.example_zh: 虫害防治施药人员必须随身携带资质证书。

vocab.example_en: Waste management contractors must segregate hazardous waste at the source.
vocab.example_zh: 废弃物管理承包商必须从源头分类危险废物。

vocab.example_en: Renovation projects require a work permit and pre-task plan.
vocab.example_zh: 翻新工程需要办理作业许可证和作业前方案。

vocab.example_en: Equipment maintenance is scheduled monthly to keep critical systems reliable.
vocab.example_zh: 设备维保按月排期，确保关键系统可靠运行。

vocab.example_en: Construction projects follow a four-stage safety management cycle.
vocab.example_zh: 施工项目遵循四阶段安全管理周期。

vocab.example_en: E. H. S. stands for Environmental, Health and Safety.
vocab.example_zh: E. H. S. 代表环境、健康与安全。

vocab.example_en: Pre-qualification is required before any contractor can bid on the project.
vocab.example_zh: 任何承包商投标前必须先通过资格预审。

vocab.example_en: Fill in the Contractor Pre-qualification Form and attach all licenses.
vocab.example_zh: 填写承包商资格预审表，并附上所有许可证。

vocab.example_en: The bid package must include pricing, schedule, and E. H. S. capability.
vocab.example_zh: 投标文件必须包含价格、进度和 E. H. S. 能力说明。

vocab.example_en: Both parties must sign the safety agreement before work begins.
vocab.example_zh: 双方必须在开工前签署安全协议。

vocab.zh: 承包商 E. H. S. 手册
vocab.example_en: The Contractor E. H. S. Manual is updated every year.
vocab.example_zh: 承包商 E. H. S. 手册每年更新一次。

vocab.example_en: A work permit is required for any hot work above 2 meters.
vocab.example_zh: 2 米以上的高处动火作业需要办理作业许可证。

vocab.example_en: Incident reporting and investigation must be completed within 24 hours.
vocab.example_zh: 事故上报与调查必须在 24 小时内完成。

vocab.example_en: Review the emergency response procedure before entering the site.
vocab.example_zh: 入场前必须学习应急处置流程。

vocab.example_en: Job Safety Analysis identifies hazards for each step of the task.
vocab.example_zh: 作业安全分析识别每一步作业的危险源。

vocab.example_en: Keep your safety training records ready for inspection at any time.
vocab.example_zh: 安全培训记录需随时备查。

vocab.example_en: Every new hire must complete safety orientation on the first day.
vocab.example_zh: 每位新员工入职第一天必须完成安全入职培训。

vocab.example_en: Web-based orientation training modules cover E. H. S. and code of conduct.
vocab.example_zh: 线上入职培训模块涵盖 E. H. S. 和行为准则。

vocab.example_en: Every contractor is subject to an annual audit by the E. H. S. team.
vocab.example_zh: 每家承包商每年接受一次 E. H. S. 团队的年度审核。

vocab.example_en: The quarterly performance review covers safety, quality, and schedule.
vocab.example_zh: 季度绩效评审涵盖安全、质量和进度。

vocab.example_en: Safety inspections are conducted weekly on high-risk work areas.
vocab.example_zh: 高风险作业区域每周开展安全检查。

vocab.example_en: Periodical safety meetings review lessons learned from the past month.
vocab.example_zh: 定期安全会议回顾过去一个月的经验教训。

vocab.example_en: Any reportable injury must be filed within 8 hours.
vocab.example_zh: 任何可记录工伤必须在 8 小时内上报。

vocab.example_en: Repeated safety citations may lead to suspension of site access.
vocab.example_zh: 多次安全违规处罚可能导致入场权限被暂停。

vocab.example_en: Verify that licences and certification are valid before starting work.
vocab.example_zh: 开工前需核验许可证与资质证书的有效性。

vocab.example_en: Each crew must designate a safety representative for the shift.
vocab.example_zh: 每个班组每个班次必须指定一名现场安全负责人。

vocab.example_en: Stage one is Pre-Qualification and Selection of qualified contractors.
vocab.example_zh: 第一阶段是资格预审与合格承包商筛选。

vocab.example_en: Pre-Job Safety covers orientation, training, and E. H. S. manual review.
vocab.example_zh: 入场安全准备涵盖入职、培训和 E. H. S. 手册学习。

vocab.example_en: On the Job Safety includes daily toolbox talks and permit checks.
vocab.example_zh: 现场作业安全包括每日班前会和许可证核查。

vocab.zh: 阶段4：作业后安全与绩效评估
vocab.example_en: Post-Job Safety reviews incident trends and lessons learned.
vocab.example_zh: 作业后安全与绩效评估复盘事故趋势与经验教训。
